1 Year Nubia Malaysia Warranty

Nubia Neo 3 5G 8+256GB

details
• 6.8-inch FHD+ (2030x900) screen, 120Hz
• Unisoc T8300 chipset, 2.2GHz Octa-core
• RAM/ROM 8+12GB RAM (Dynamic) / 256GB ROM
• Rear camera 50MP (AF) + 2MP
• 16MP front camera
• 6000mAh battery, 33W fast charging
• Network Supports 5G, Dual SIM
• Sound system, dual speakers DTS:X Ultra
• OS MyOS (Android)

> Cutting-edge design
• Mecha Design: Futuristic design with realistic 3D effects.
• RGB lighting: Inspired by the lights of sports cars, it adds a striking touch to the device.

> Ultimate gaming experience
• Gaming Shoulder Triggers: These buttons can be set to work independently and provide more precise control over your games, especially FPS games.
• 6.8 inch screen (120Hz Refresh Rate)
• Smooth and clear images with a resolution of 2030x900 pixels
• Z-axis Linear Motor Vibration Motor: Provides realistic vibration while gaming.

> Battery and charging
• 6000mAh battery supports 33W fast charging
• Bypass Charging: Direct power supply system helps reduce heat while gaming.

> Powerful performance with AI
• Unisoc T8300 chipset (6nm, 2.2GHz)
• RAM up to 20GB (8GB+12GB Virtual RAM) / ROM 256GB
• AI Game Space 3.0: Automatically optimizes games
• AI Trigger: Detects your playing behavior and automatically helps you press frequently used buttons.
• AI Virtual Companion "Demi": An AI assistant that can chat and give various notifications.

> Camera system and AI photography
• Dual rear camera 50MP + 2MP / Front camera 16MP
• AI Super Night Shot: Take sharp night shots
• AI HDR: Captures better image details
• AI Magic Photography: Object removal feature, intelligent photo editing

> AI language translation
• AI Real-time Translate: Translate voice in real time during calls
• AI Conversation Translate: Supports text and voice translation for face-to-face conversations.

> Other features
• Advanced cooling system
• Live Island 2.0: Show dynamic notifications
• Z-SmartCast: Share your mobile screen to other devices.
• Waterproof and dustproof level IP54
• Network

✔ Shoulder Triggers for gaming

✔ Mecha design with RGB lights
✔ 120Hz large screen + DTS:X Ultra dual speakers
✔ 6000mAh long-lasting battery + 33W fast charging
